_note: All images are original AI-generated editorial illustrations made for Lupa (Nov 2026). They do not depict real companies, products, facilities or people. Source files live in content/images/<name>.jpg; run scripts/process_images.py to (re)build optimised derivatives into src/assets/img/.

alt.hr: Mjedeno povećalo leži na stranici novina s gustim tablicama cijena dionica, osvijetljeno kosim popodnevnim svjetlom.
alt.en: A brass magnifying glass resting on a newspaper page of dense stock price tables, lit by low afternoon light.

caption.hr: Povećalo nad tablicama: Lupin način rada.
caption.en: A lens over the tables: how Lupa works.

alt.hr: Red robotiziranih laboratorijskih kolica s robotskim rukama i mikropločama u zatamnjenom laboratoriju.
alt.en: A row of robotic lab carts with robot arms and microplates in a darkened laboratory.

caption.hr: Autonomni laboratorij, ilustracija. Ne prikazuje Ginkgov stvarni pogon.
caption.en: An autonomous lab, illustration. Not Ginkgo's actual facility.

alt.hr: Robotski nastavci za pipetiranje spuštaju se nad mikroploču s jažicama u nijansama jantara i tirkiza.
alt.en: Robotic pipette tips descending over a microplate whose wells shade from amber to teal.

caption.hr: Testovi poput ADME-a rade se u stotinama jažica istodobno.
caption.en: Assays such as ADME run in hundreds of wells at once.

alt.hr: Prazan, neiskorišten laboratorijski prostor s prekrivenom opremom i jednom zrakom sunca.
alt.en: An empty, unused laboratory floor with covered equipment and a single shaft of sunlight.

caption.hr: Neiskorišten prostor i dalje se plaća. Ilustracija.
caption.en: Unused space still has to be paid for. Illustration.

alt.hr: Vakuumska komora od nehrđajućeg čelika na optičkom stolu, s oblakom hladnih atoma u sredini i laserskim zrakama.
alt.en: A stainless-steel vacuum chamber on an optical table with a glowing cloud of cold atoms and crossing laser beams.

caption.hr: Hladni atomi i laseri, ilustracija. Ne prikazuje Infleqtionov stvarni sustav.
caption.en: Cold atoms and lasers, illustration. Not Infleqtion's actual system.

alt.hr: Pravilna rešetka sitnih svjetlećih točaka u tami, nalik atomima zarobljenima optičkim pincetama.
alt.en: A regular grid of tiny glowing points in darkness, like atoms held in optical tweezers.

caption.hr: Rešetka neutralnih atoma: svaka točka je jedan kubit. Ilustracija.
caption.en: A neutral-atom array: each point is one qubit. Illustration.

alt.hr: Mali sivi istraživački brod na otvorenom moru u zoru, pod oblačnim nebom.
alt.en: A small grey research vessel on the open sea at dawn under a cloudy sky.

caption.hr: Precizno mjerenje vremena na moru, kada GPS nije dostupan. Ilustracija, ne prikazuje RV Merlin.
caption.en: Precision timing at sea, when GPS is unavailable. Illustration, not RV Merlin.

alt.hr: Zamućena svjetla burzovnih zaslona u crvenoj i zelenoj boji iza kišom orošenog prozora noću.
alt.en: Blurred red and green market screen lights behind a rain-streaked window at night.

caption.hr: Utorak, 10. studenoga: inflacija i kamate ponovno u središtu pozornosti.
caption.en: Tuesday, 10 November: inflation and rates back in focus.

alt.hr: Kružni radarski snop svjetla na papiru na stolu, sa šest jantarnih oznaka i nalivperom.
alt.en: A circular radar sweep of light on paper on a desk, with six amber markers and a fountain pen.

alt.hr: Presavijeni tiskani istraživački bilten, šalica crne kave i mobitel na lanenom stolnjaku u jutarnjem svjetlu.
alt.en: A folded printed research briefing, a cup of black coffee and a phone on a linen tablecloth in morning light.

alt.hr: Valjci starinske tiskarske preše natopljeni tirkiznom bojom iznad sloga metalnih slova.
alt.en: Teal-inked rollers of a vintage printing press above a bed of metal type.

alt.hr: Hrpe tiskanih godišnjih izvješća s ljepljivim oznakama, flomaster, naočale i bilježnica sa skicama grafikona.
alt.en: Stacks of printed annual reports with sticky tabs, a highlighter, glasses and a notebook with chart sketches.
